provenance.annotationMethod: Original visual review of all 27225 extracted native visuals and four separately captured native-interface visuals. Exact-pixel aliases expand only with per-ID extraction proof; 160 non-native original sample records are preserved unchanged.
provenance.identityLimit: Build 71037 native provider export only. 27711 IDs use exact unencrypted local FileDataID pixels; four use UI-scaled/composited screenshot crops, not BLP/content-key identity. Visual descriptions are not authoritative spell/item names or gameplay mechanics. Future builds and additional character-only textures are not guaranteed.
provenance.coverage: 27715 of 27715 unique exported native IDs; 27875 indexed IDs including 160 preserved non-native originals. Native provider has 27765 rows and 50 duplicate rows, preserved by runtime.
provenance.artDisposition: Images and contact sheets are not redistributed. Only original text annotations and identity/provenance metadata are included.

nativeReview.extractedPixelHashScope: SHA256(uint32le width + uint32le height + unscaled first-mipmap RGBA bytes)
nativeReview.screenshotPixelHashScope: SHA256(uint32le width + uint32le height + RGBA screenshot-crop bytes); UI scaling/compositing already present

legacySample.annotationMethod: Original English annotations from visual inspection of all 576 acquired images; eight filename-defined strata, 72 images each. Keywords are visual descriptions, not authoritative spell/item names.
legacySample.selectionRule: Within each filename-defined stratum, ascending SHA256(lowercase originalPath); first 120 fetched; first 72 successful distinct image hashes selected; deterministic top-up from reserves to 576 if needed
legacySample.identityLimit: Filename match does not prove pixel identity with a specific installed client FileDataID; no client archive was extracted and no runtime provider catalogue was exported
legacySample.coverage: Broad WoW community listfile sample; NOT an exported native Forever picker catalogue
legacySample.artDisposition: Images and contact sheets are not redistributed. Only original text annotations and identity/provenance metadata are included.
